name: Orvil Juárez
headline: CEO & Owner
about:
I am a specialist in backend development with Linux, Python, Flask and PostgreSQL/MySQL. Iḿ specialist too in frontend development with pure Vue.js or using Tailwind CSS, Vuetify or Quasar.

I have developed web applications such as: Point of Sale (POS) integrated with credit card payments (Authorize.net, Stripe, Paypal and Mercado Pago), Inventory and Production Control, Shipping and Distribution, Accounting, Payroll Calculation, Attendance, Access control with barcode, Reports with real time sales graphs, and my best and biggest development was a complete ERP System.

I have extensive experience in Asterisk PBX and VICIdial. I have developed an interface for Asterisk PBX with modules of Progressive and Automatic Dialer (Blaster) integrated with TTS (Text to Speech), Reports of calls in real time and administration of extensions and user among others, using Python, Flask, HTML/Bootstrap and MySQL templates.

I have extensive knowledge in the use of cloud platform services such as AWS, GCP and Digital Ocean.

I also have extensive experience in managing work teams (Software Architects, Programmers and Designers) as well as in the use of SCRUM methodologies and related tools and Lean Startup.

experiences.description:
Desarrollo e Implementación de Aplicaciones Web, Desktop y para dispositivos Móviles Android e iOS utilizando Python, Flask, JavaScript, Vue 3, Node, Express, Vuetify, Quasar, Tailwind, Ionic, Flutter, Raw SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB y Firebase. 
Configuración e implementación de servicios en la nube de AWS, GCP y Digital Ocean. 
Configuración e implementación de Docker y Kubernetes. 
Configuración e implementación de servidores Linux (Debian/Ubuntu/CentOS), Servidores Linux VoIP con Asterisk, Call Centers con VICIdial, Migración de Sistemas a Open Source con Linux y de Sistemas Libres ERP y CRM (OpenERP, VTiger, SugarCRM).
Desarrollo de jacERP un ERP propio para empresas de Fast Food y cualquier tipo de restaurante.
Desarrollo de jacPBX una interfáz gráfica para administración de Asterisk en Call Centers el cual incluye módulos de Blaster, Marcador Progresivo, Text to speech, envío de SMS y integración con sistemas externos para generar llamadas.
